text:
jules_pm: Quick compact sync — last internal GA gate for Edge-Optimized. Need: finalized SLA wording for contracts, one-page pricing examples for AE, runbook alert levels, docs quickstart, and oncall rota. Goal: signoff by Fri EOD.

rachel_se: I can validate infra + autoscale. Please confirm SLO buckets: <=1KB and >1KB. Also need decision on p99 guardrail.

marco_fin: I'll prepare 3 sample invoices (Pilot, Growth, Enterprise) with Reserved vs Burst breakdown. Need avg tokens/request and expected monthly hours. If you drop numbers here, I can model quickly.

 taylor_docs: I'll author quickstart and migration checklist. Need approved SLA blurb and a concise "what breaks look like" customer note.

 sam_oncall: Runbook owner here. Propose alerts: warn p95>140ms, page p95>220ms for 10m, page if error rate>1% for 3m. Include template customer comms for S1.

 ci-bot: Canary pipeline: edge-ga/canary build #510 succeeded; traffic @4% in eu-west.

 jules_pm: Decisions to make: (1) SLA numeric targets (propose p95=150ms for <=1KB, p99 soft guardrail 300ms), (2) billing lanes (Reserved monthly commit, OnDemandBurst pay-per-use), (3) service-credit formula (marco to propose).

 rachel_se: agree on SLOs above. Add tagging for request size buckets. Risk: long-decode models blow tail unless prefix-cache enabled. I'll toggle cache for canary.

 marco_fin: I'll draft invoice examples and a service-credit table: small breach -> 2% credit, large -> 10%. Will post by Thu noon.

 taylor_docs: SLA blurb draft for public docs: "Redwood Edge-Optimized targets p95 latency <=150ms for <=1KB requests; eligibility for service credits subject to contract definitions." Will open PR.

 sam_oncall: runbook snippet:
- p95>220ms for 10m -> page infra-oncall
- error rate>1% for 3m -> declare Sev1, page incident commander
- GPU pool >85% and queue rising -> trigger emergency-burst scale

 jules_pm: Owners: SLA + contract draft -> marco_fin + legal, Pricing examples -> marco_fin, Docs quickstart + migration -> taylor_docs, Runbook + dashboards -> sam_oncall + rachel_se, Infra gating + canary toggle -> rachel_se. Deliverables due Thu EOD.

 jules_pm: If no major blockers, schedule 30m shiproom Fri 09:30 PT for final signoff. React :thumbsup: if you can attend.

 marco_fin: :thumbsup:

 taylor_docs: :thumbsup:

 rachel_se: :thumbsup:

 sam_oncall: :thumbsup:

 jules_pm: I'll consolidate PR links here when submitted. Keep updates in-thread only.
